meta.description: Securely integrate with the official LabArchives ELN REST-like API and Inventory API v1. Use for regional endpoint selection, signed-request construction, user authorization and UID flows, local LA container validation, and verified LabArchives integration workflows.

scientific_integrity.detail: Infrastructure integration skill, not research methodology

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive ELN and Inventory API coverage with regional endpoints, authentication, LA container validation; 4 reference files; minor gaps: no complete workflow examples, limited error scenario coverage

reliability.note: Good documentation of non-versioned API surface with official page verification requirement; explicit acknowledgment of shared notebook documentation; minor: no explicit retry guidance

performance_context.note: Well-structured 217-line SKILL.md with 4 reference files; clear API surface distinction; minor: density could be improved with more reference delegation

agent_usability.note: Good trigger description with specific LabArchives patterns; clear API surface distinction; missing: explicit 'When to Use' section, some integration patterns unclear

human_usability.note: Excellent setup instructions with uv, named environment variables, regional endpoint documentation, and validation scripts

security.note: Perfect: HTTPS-only, allowlisted hosts, no credential logging, timeout enforcement, XML/JSON as untrusted, rate limiting, UID binding documented

maintainability.note: Good with version 1.1, license, compatibility; dated sources documented; missing: changelog, no upstream SDK version tracking

agent_specific.note: Good composability with bundled network-free tools; clear safety rules; minor: workflow orchestration limited, no complete end-to-end examples, integration patterns could be more explicit

key_strengths: Perfect security posture: HTTPS-only, allowlisted hosts, no credential logging, timeouts enforced, XML/JSON untrusted, rate limiting, UID binding documented
Clear API surface distinction preventing cross-contamination between ELN query-based auth and Inventory header-based auth
Comprehensive authentication documentation with complete HMAC-SHA-512 algorithm for both ELN and Inventory APIs
Excellent credential management with 5 named environment variables and bundled network-free validation tools
Strong emphasis on official page verification before implementation due to non-versioned shared notebook documentation

recommendations.title: Add specific retry logic and eligible status codes
recommendations.problem: General retry guidance but no specific eligible transient failure codes or backoff formula
recommendations.root_cause: Security focus on preventing inappropriate retries rather than specifying safe patterns
recommendations.fix: Add to operational rules: eligible retry status codes (502, 503, 504, 429), exponential backoff formula (1s, 2s, 4s), max retry count (3), and safe idempotency checks

recommendations.title: Clarify when to use product integrations vs API automation
recommendations.problem: Product integrations listed but no guidance on automation appropriateness
recommendations.root_cause: Agent usability focuses on API details rather than integration strategy
recommendations.fix: Add to integrations.md: decision criteria for when to use UI-based product integrations (Jupyter, REDCap, etc.) vs building custom API automation

recommendations.title: Add complete end-to-end workflow examples
recommendations.problem: Individual API calls documented but no complete multi-step workflow
recommendations.root_cause: Agent-specific composability focuses on individual operations rather than orchestration
recommendations.fix: Add to api_reference.md: complete example showing config validation → plan generation → approval → execute → verify response for both ELN entry creation and Inventory item query

recommendations.title: Add explicit 'When to Use' section
recommendations.problem: Trigger description mentions LabArchives but no explicit use-case section
recommendations.root_cause: Agent usability relies on description rather than structured use-case guidance
recommendations.fix: Add section: Use this skill when automating LabArchives notebook entries, retrieving experimental data, integrating with pipelines, or validating LA container exports. Do not use for manual notebook editing or one-off data entry.
